<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0032026-03-0217-11-22" status="unreviewed">yang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3786">kha 1</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">lo</rs></note> na re dgag pa'i rjes dpag gis dgag bya'i dngos po 'jal bas gzhal bya la dngos pos khyab ste des na buM med rtogs pa'i tshad mas kyang buM med : mi 'jal bar buM pa'i dngos po 'jal ba'o || ji ltar na buM pa de buM med rtogs pa'i mi slu ba'i ltos pa yin te de med na tshad ma yod la yod na med pa'i phyir ro | |
               <lb n="81b3"/>buM pa de bu med kyi chos can yin pas kyang chos 'jal ba la chos can 'jal dgos pas kyang buM pa 'jal la chos rnaMs kyi 1 la 1 sgro btags yin pas kyang dngos pos khyab pa'o zhes zer ||</seg></TEI>
